name: Familiar
author: Shresht Bhowmick
description: A little pixel fox that lives in your bar and reacts to your day: sleeps when you're away, types along with your agents, wears headphones to your music, hops when you commit. Right-click tucks it into a zero-battery nap.

barWidget.description: A pixel fox that reacts to what you're doing. Click to pet, scroll for belly rubs, middle-click for a berry, right-click to tuck it in.

schema.label: Nap whenever unplugged
schema.description: A nap is one still frame with every timer and check stopped.

schema.label: Where your repos live
schema.description: New commits here make it hop.
